title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libkcapi security update
description: A memory corruption vulnerability exists in libkcapi due to uncanceled asynchronous I/O (AIO) requests on error in its one-shot AIO path. libkcapi is a user-space library that interfaces with the Linux kernel crypto API via netlink, allowing unprivileged processes to access kernel cryptographic services. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-71226 and has been rated as having moderate security impact by Red Hat. An update addressing this issue is available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.8 variants.
